summary: Attempt 2 does O-001 and nothing else. The arming code moved out of Scans.RunCancellingAt into `internal static void Scans.CancelAt(SynchronousIoCancel guard, CancellationTokenSource cts, int call, bool during)`. RunCancellingAt is now `WithGuard(g => CancelAt(g, cts, call, during), () => scan(root, cts.Token))`. The during-the-call cancel-and-spin is now a single shared `Scans.CancelDuringTheCall(cts, guard)`, which CancelAt calls. SynchronousIoCancelTests' private copy is deleted and its two call sites use the Scans method. CancelledFolderTests.AnAbortedListingKeepsNothingOfTheBuffersBeforeIt now calls Scans.CancelAt instead of its own arming block. That was the copy that had lost the 'the canceller never marked the call' message. `git grep` now finds that spin and message only at Scans.cs:166. The full suite passes 394/394.

files.why: Attempt 1 added WithGuard and RunCancellingAt. Attempt 2 (O-001) adds CancelAt, which holds the only arming code, and CancelDuringTheCall, which holds the only cancel-and-spin with its message. RunCancellingAt is rebuilt on CancelAt.
From attempt 1, unchanged in attempt 2: CancelAtAnyCallLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals uses Scans.WithGuard and Scans.RunCancellingAt.

Attempt 1: CancelAtAnyCallCommitsOnlyWholeFolders uses WithGuard and RunCancellingAt. Attempt 2 (O-001): AnAbortedListingKeepsNothingOfTheBuffersBeforeIt's hand-written before/during arming block is replaced by Scans.CancelAt(guard, cts, ThirdBuffer, duringTheCall).
O-001: deleted the private CancelDuringTheCall helper. AnAbortedCallsHandleIsClosedOffTheScanThread's two AfterCall hooks now call the shared Scans.CancelDuringTheCall.

obligations.how: Added `internal static void Scans.CancelAt(SynchronousIoCancel guard, CancellationTokenSource cts, int call, bool during)`. It arms BeforeCall, or AfterCall through the shared spin, at call k. RunCancellingAt is now `WithGuard(g => CancelAt(g, cts, call, during), () => scan(root, cts.Token))`. AnAbortedListingKeepsNothingOfTheBuffersBeforeIt's arming block, formerly CancelledFolderTests.cs:123-140, is now one call: `Scans.CancelAt(guard, cts, ThirdBuffer, duringTheCall)`. SynchronousIoCancelTests.CancelDuringTheCall is replaced by `internal static Scans.CancelDuringTheCall(cts, guard)`, and CancelAt and both SynchronousIoCancelTests call sites use it. `git grep "CancelIsIssued, TimeSpan\|canceller never marked" -- tests` now finds the spin and message only at Scans.cs:166. The only other hit, SynchronousIoCancelTests.cs:221, waits for !CancelIsIssued, which is a different shape and was left alone. No product code was needed.
